name: Colt's Divine Duty
source:
In a small village hidden in the mountains, a young acolyte is sent to serve the gods. His duty is to help them, and in doing so, strengthen the bonds between them.

[From [url=https://vmhol.itch.io/colts-divine-duty]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个隐藏在山中的小村庄里，一名年轻的侍僧被派去侍奉神灵。他的职责是帮助他们，并以此加强他们之间的联系。

[来自[url=https://vmhol.itch.io/colts-divine-duty]Itch.io[/url]]
